scope: Read-method safety for capture commands and YouTube authorization
capture_reproduction: Before the fix, isolated HEAD with command payload invoked the mocked effect
verified: GET and HEAD capture status never dispatch commands, including JSON and form payloads
Capture POST commands require authorization and CSRF; invalid commands and unsupported methods are rejected
YouTube action HEAD redirects without calling authorization, refresh or revoke effects
YouTube callback HEAD leaves pending OAuth state intact and does not exchange tokens
A subsequent valid OAuth GET callback still succeeds

regression.sequence: Full regression on capture fix, then targeted OAuth flow and module compilation repeated after YouTube extension

limits: Service and Google effects simulated in isolated tests
This evidence does not establish complete product acceptance or Classic independence
